questions.stem: In the context of translocation, what is meant by a 'source' and a 'sink'?

options.text: A source is where water enters the plant; a sink is where water leaves
A source is where sugars are produced or released; a sink is where sugars are used or stored
A source is the root; a sink is always the leaf
A source is any organ above ground; a sink is any organ below ground

questions.explanation: A source is an organ that produces or releases sugars (such as photosynthesising leaves or storage organs releasing stored starch). A sink is an organ that uses or stores sugars (such as growing roots, developing fruits, or storage organs building up starch reserves).
